sql: select 'listeners_total' as k, ''::text as a, count(*)::text as b, ''::text as c from evo_listeners union all select 'listener_events','',count(*)::text,'' from evo_listener_events union all select 'hb_degraded_by_day', to_char(created_at,'MM-DD'), count(*)::text, '' from evo_heartbeats where status='degraded' and created_at > now() - interval '14 days' group by 1,2 union all select 'budget_util', kind, count(*)::text, round(max(used/nullif(limit_value,0))::numeric,3)::text from evo_budgets group by 1,2 union all select 'fitness7', 'scored='||(scored_at is not null)::text, count(*)::text, '' from evo_fitness f join evo_cohorts c on c.id=f.cohort_id where c.number=7 group by 1,2 order by 1,2
